library_use.reason: Immutable source ledgers already contain exact source locations, claim statuses, design ceilings, and coordinator full-text spot-checks sufficient for the bounded source/claim packet. The remaining blockers are project-governance authority objects; additional source-body reading cannot create them.

anchors: T3:S01 Marx Capital I ch6 — property separation / recurrent material dependency
T3:S04 Marx Capital I ch23 — recurrent reproduction of material dependency
T3:S08 Wright Class Counts ch1 pp16-18 — property/authority/skill relations as concrete mechanisms
COORDINATOR:MC01 / P1 source-grounding — Wright, Elder, social-reproduction materials
source_claim_packet.claim_ceiling: Supports an exact resource/access/dependency rule shape only when concrete resource/right/access and actor-position/context/time determinants are independently proven. It does not license CLASS -> RESOURCE STATE or missing evidence -> NO_ACCESS.

candidates.measurement_estimand_identification: NOT_APPLICABLE_FOR_THIS_NONNUMERIC_CONSTITUTIVE_POSSIBILITY_RULE_SHAPE; exact N/A scope basis must be conserved at admission
candidates.calibration: NOT_APPLICABLE_NONNUMERIC; any later numeric quantity/threshold specialization is a distinct rule requiring current calibration authority

anchors: T3:S03 Marx Capital I ch15 — concrete supervision/penalty/authority conditions
T3:S08 Wright Class Counts ch1 pp16-18 — authority/surveillance/sanction relations
T6:S05 Merton Role-Set pp113-118 — counterpart-specific expectations/powers/sanctions
COORDINATOR:P2 grounding — Wright, Kohn/Schooler, Merton, Dreier, care/household materials
source_claim_packet.claim_ceiling: Supports directed authority/obligation/sanction rule shapes only from actual operative relation and duty authority. TITLE != AUTHORITY; obligation != performance/enforcement.

anchors: T3:S03 Marx Capital I ch15 — concrete technical/work organization and pacing
T3:S05 Braverman pp78-83 — division of labour/conception-execution separation
T4:S02 Kohn/Schooler 1982 pp1258,1261,1281-82 — actual job-condition decomposition; occupational title is insufficient
T4:S13 Staff/Mortimer 2024 — within-person work-quality variation with explicit direction/lag ceiling
COORDINATOR:MC03/MC05 / P3 grounding — actual work/activity/time conditions
source_claim_packet.claim_ceiling: Supports organization-owned activity/schedule and task/time availability shapes. Schedule/opportunity != attendance or performed activity; occupation/employment label != task content or work quality.

candidates.measurement_estimand_identification: NOT_APPLICABLE_FOR_NONNUMERIC_ROUTE_AVAILABILITY; empirical work-quality measures may not be imported as actor facts
candidates.calibration: NOT_APPLICABLE_NONNUMERIC; any numeric timing/capacity threshold requires a distinct calibrated rule

anchors: T6:S06 Bertrand/Mullainathan 2004 AER 94(4):991-1013 — field experiment, cue -> callback under study gate
T6:S07 Pager 2003 AJS 108(5):937-975 — matched field audit, record/cue -> callback treatment under study gate
T6:S08 Correll/Benard/Paik 2007 AJS 112(5):1297-1338 — lab + field audit gate-treatment evidence
COORDINATOR:MC06 / P4 grounding — eligibility/credential/policy structures plus bounded gate-treatment evidence
source_claim_packet.claim_ceiling: The experiments strongly support bounded cue/gate/treatment causal identification for their designs, but they do not issue a universal gate rule or authorize ATTRIBUTE -> TREATMENT. This C05 candidate is K1 eligibility, not K3 callback/treatment occurrence; exact institution-owned eligibility predicates remain mandatory.

candidates.measurement_estimand_identification: NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_K1_ELIGIBILITY_RULE_BODY; experimental identification evidence is retained as mechanism/negative-ceiling evidence and may not be relabeled as generic eligibility authority
candidates.calibration: NOT_APPLICABLE_NONNUMERIC; later numeric cutoff or probability is a distinct calibrated rule

anchors: T6:S01 Feld 1981 AJS 86(5):1015-1035 — foci organize joint activity/counterpart opportunity, not automatic ties
T6:S02 Granovetter 1973 AJS 78(6):1360-1380 — bridge caveat and nonredundant information route
T6:S04 Coleman 1988 AJS supplement S95-S120 — decomposed information/obligation/sanction channels, generic social-capital stock rejected

source_claim_packet.claim_ceiling: Supports exact counterpart/channel/reachability possibility only. SHARED_FOCUS != TIE; TIE != CONTACT; CHANNEL != TRANSFER/RECEIPT/SUPPORT; NETWORK_METRIC != BENEFIT.
